newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-BOLAND BEAT WESTERN TRANSVAAL 16-11.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BOLAND BEAT WESTERN TRANSVAAL 16-11.

text.p: A dramatic last-minute try from lock Johnnie Trytsman helped Boland to a 16-11 (halftime 11-6) victory over Western Transvaal at the Boland Stadium in Wellington on Saturday.
It was a dour battle between two honest but uninspired teams although the Bolanders may have deserved a win because of the superiority of their forwards, particularly at the point of breakdown.
Right wing Francois Horn put Boland ahead with two penalties in the first 15 minutes and then added his teams first try with a jinking run that saw him beat two tackles.
Western Tranvaal scored their first points with two penalties from fullback Jaco Coetzee before left wing Charl Bensch was gifted a try through sloppy defence.
With the scores level at 11-11 and only one minute remaining, replacement scrumhalf Christoff Lotter and fullback Marius Goosen combined to send Trytsman plunging over for the winning score.
Boland: Tries - Francois Horn, Johnnie Trytsman. Penalties: Francois Horn (2)
Western Transvaal: Try: Charl Bensch. Penalties: Jaco Coetzee (2).
